source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 4ης Μαΐου — «Άγιοι Αφροδίσιος, Μίσδας, Μακρόβιος, Ουαλεριανός, Λεόντιος, Αντωνίνος οι Μάρτυρες και οι συν αυτοίς εν Σκυθουπόλει (Συρίας) μαρτυρησάντων»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 4 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and enumerates the company by name, so this is one of six folders. **He is not `macrobius-of-tomis`**, and the separation is clean: that folder is kept on **13 September** by all four calendars, and he is one of the martyrs of Tomis in Scythia Minor, whose company includes `valerian-of-tomis`. **This is a real trap and it goes further than the name**: the Tomis company and this one each contain a Valerian and a Macrobius, and Scythopolis and Scythia are one letter apart in English and nothing alike in Greek — Σκυθούπολις in Syria against Τόμις. The day settles it: 4 Μαΐου against 13 Σεπτεμβρίου. His only line of his own is the couplet he shares with Valerian, «Yπέρ κεφαλάς Mαρτύρων αρθέν δύω, / Aθλητικήν έπηξε πυρ αυτοίς στέγην» — fire, raised above the heads of two martyrs, fixed a contender's roof over them — which speaks of fire where the story has stones and clubs, and the page does not reconcile the two. No year, no emperor, no hymn, no relic.
